name: Gasthof Weisses Rössl am See
beschreibung:
Directly perched on the shore of sparkling Lake Thiersee, Weisses Roessl features comfortable rooms with lake vistas and outstanding regional cuisine, including fresh local fish.

The lake promenade, the fortress town of Kufstein, and alpine trails are right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Weisses Roessl am See in Thiersee delights guests with a direct lakeside setting and alpine delicacies.
